WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.frequency,
        AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        frequency,
        average_transaction_amount,
        average_transaction_amount /
            AVG(average_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    frequency,
    average_transaction_amount,
    ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Average the stored unsigned trans.amount values as given; the request asks for transaction amount, and does not specify signed net transaction amounts.
